purpose: Admit, validate, idempotently archive, and acknowledge one delivered Sync Checkpoint under Wire Protocol Version 1 without trusting the Sender's wall clock: answer with exactly one Delivery Receipt, retryable failure, or Delivery Block whose bytes match ingest-protocol's own evaluation for a delivering installation, archive the exact envelope and its health-data-free polling report before any receipt, keep pending, ended, and unknown installations retryable as accept-ingest-batch does, never block a checkpoint for implausible Sender times, and report one Sender Installation's Polling Freshness from Portal receipt time together with its time-stamped last reported Background Scheduling Status, visible non-blocking clock-skew and scheduling conditions, and exact per-type lifecycle outcomes.

inputs.name: delivered_bytes
inputs.description: The exact uncompressed bytes of one valid Sync Checkpoint, which the ingress shell routes here after decoding its kind.

inputs.name: receipt_time
inputs.description: The timezone-aware Portal time of the delivery, supplied by the caller and recorded as the receipt time, Last Delivery, and latest checkpoint receipt.

inputs.name: installation_id
inputs.description: The Sender Installation whose polling state is read.

inputs.name: read_time
inputs.description: The timezone-aware Portal time at which polling state is read, against which Polling Freshness and the first-checkpoint deadline are measured.

inputs.name: operational_state
inputs.description: The Operational Store's installation lifecycle states and times, honored capability advertisements, archived message identities, sequence history and gaps, archived checkpoints, the latest checkpoint receipt and Background Scheduling Status, and storage reserve, read and written through operational-store@2.

inputs.name: free_space
inputs.description: Free bytes on the store's filesystem, which the store compares with its reserve when archiving.

outputs.name: delivery_response
outputs.description: accept-ingest-batch@1's DeliveryResponse: exactly one of a Delivery Receipt echoing the installation, sequence, and message SHA-256; a retryable failure with reason storage-reserve-exhausted or temporarily-unavailable; or a Delivery Block naming one closed ingest-protocol failure with the message's identity, together with its named failure and any accepted sequence gap.

outputs.name: archived_checkpoint
outputs.description: For a newly accepted checkpoint, the exact envelope, receipt, receipt time, staged generation, and polling report (run sequence, trigger, the Sender's start and end times and elapsed duration kept as diagnostic claims, Background Scheduling Status, each record type's outcome, reason, and source-data-staged flag, and pre-checkpoint outbox counts) archived in one store transaction with Last Delivery, the latest checkpoint receipt time, the time-stamped Background Scheduling Status, and any sequence gap. No Health Summary, Data Watermark, Cutover Record, or source evidence changes. Nothing for a retry, retryable failure, or Delivery Block.

outputs.name: delivery_block_record
outputs.description: A health-data-free Delivery Block record for every block: installation, sequence, message SHA-256, failure, and first and last seen times.

outputs.name: polling_state
outputs.description: For one Sender Installation at a read time: Polling Freshness, never-reported before its first accepted checkpoint and otherwise current through six hours, delayed after six, and stale after 24 from the latest checkpoint's Portal receipt time; whether a never-reported installation has a first poll in progress or is past its first-checkpoint deadline; the last reported Background Scheduling Status with its receipt time, stale when Polling Freshness is stale; the clock-skew and scheduling conditions; and the latest checkpoint with its exact per-type outcomes and diagnostic Sender timing. Reading writes nothing.

observable_effects.name: operational-store-write
observable_effects.description: Archives a newly accepted Sync Checkpoint, or records a health-data-free Delivery Block, through operational-store@2; retries, retryable failures, and polling-state reads write nothing.

owns: the order in which a delivered checkpoint is checked, and the mapping of each check to a receipt, retryable failure, or Delivery Block
turning a decoded Sync Checkpoint into the store's exact checkpoint record
deriving Polling Freshness, its never-reported setup states, and the clock-skew and scheduling conditions from archived facts and a Portal read time
does_not_own: wire schemas, exact bytes, the lifecycle outcome, reason, trigger, and scheduling vocabularies, and the closed failure vocabularies, which belong to ingest-protocol
the store's schema, transactions, retry identity, checkpoint history, latest checkpoint receipt, recorded Background Scheduling Status, and storage reserve, which belong to operational-store
installation lifecycle transitions and capability generations, which belong to manage-sender-installation
the DeliveryResponse type, undecodable and non-Outbox bytes, and Ingest Batches, which belong to accept-ingest-batch
HTTP routing, request limits, decompression, and Authorized Ingress, which belong to the Portal ingress shell
the wording, prominence, and rendering of polling state and its conditions, which belong to portal-state-presentation
the Sender's Polling Runs, checkpoint content, scheduling observation, and local notification, which belong to coordinate-sender-sync, stage-sync-checkpoint, and schedule-background-polling
